0022600157.text: The Lakers, who are 4-2 and 1st in the Pacific, host the 3-2 Toronto Raptors, who are 5th in the East and 2 games back in the Atlantic, in Los Angeles' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. The Lakers are 2-1 at home and have lost their last game, while the Raptors are 2-1 at home and 1-1 on the road, and the teams have not met yet this season. Los Angeles won both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026, and will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), while Toronto will be missing Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture).
